name: cgam_cogeneration
title: CGAM cogeneration benchmark (gas turbine + HRSG)
summary: Design-point CGAM problem (Valero et al. 1994) as built in the TESPy test suite: gas turbine with air preheater and HRSG (economiser, drum, evaporator) delivering 14 kg/s of saturated steam at 20 bar and 30 MW net power; the fuel flow follows from the TIT, the air flow from the net power; ideal-gas mixture air/flue gas, Water on the steam side.

authors: Francesco Witte and the TESPy contributors
origin.course: CGAM problem (Valero et al., Energy 19(3) 1994) as built in TESPy test_CGAM_model.py (commit 19425523); reference data tests/test_models/cgam-ebsilon-results.csv

verification.summary: vs the Ebsilon table (cgam-ebsilon-results.csv): compressor power 29.764 vs 29.6597 MW (3.5e-03), turbine 59.764 vs 59.6597 MW (1.7e-03), max 5.7e-03 on ds[6]-ds[4]; vs a TESPy re-run (0.11.3.dev0, commit 19425523, 2026-10-19): max 2.9e-03 on ds[7]-ds[4].
verification.reference: TESPy re-run of the source network (~/svn/tespy commit 19425523, test_CGAM_model.py without the exergy analysis) and the Ebsilon results table tests/test_models/cgam-ebsilon-results.csv
verification.notes: vs Ebsilon: max 5.70e-03 on ds[6]-ds[4] (4.74e-03 before the CO2 partial pressures below 1000 Pa were no longer clamped), ds[7]-ds[4] 4.2e-03, W_comp 3.5e-03, W_turb 1.7e-03, T7 3.2e-03 (method of the source test: h and s as same-composition differences). vs the TESPy re-run of 2026-10-19: max 2.85e-03 on ds[7]-ds[4], W_comp 2.3e-03, T7 2.2e-03 (2.03e-03 before the re-baseline). The clamp had suppressed the CO2 pressure term of the air entropy across the compressor. CoolSolve H2O entropy is the third-law NASA value (~3.5 kJ/kg-K above CoolProp HEOS), a constant offset that cancels in all same-composition entropy differences of the model.

history.action: added (T-TRANSLATE of the TESPy CGAM test model, card C-191, inventory row TSP-050); verified against a TESPy re-run and the Ebsilon table of the source test

re-baselined with CoolSolve 0.3.0@4798e2b: the CO2 partial pressures (30-300 Pa in the air) are no longer clamped to 1000 Pa (CS-BUG-INPUT-CLAMP); T2 611.48 -> 611.60 K, T7 431.15 -> 431.42 K, m_air 91.063 -> 91.100 kg/s, W_comp 29.740 -> 29.764 MW; the maximum deviation from the Ebsilon table moves from 4.7e-03 to 5.7e-03 (ds[6]-ds[4]), slightly above the 5e-03 bound of the source test; status unchanged
